in_marathi.name: Deepa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Row of lamps or light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepa is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'deep' meaning 'a row of lamps' or 'a light'. In Hindu mythology, Deepa is a symbol of knowledge and enlightenment, representing the inner light that guides one through the darkness of ignorance. It is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is believed to bestow wealth and prosperity upon her devotees.

vedic_reference.note: Deepa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deep' which means 'light'. In Hindu mythology, Deepa is often used to refer to the earthen lamps used during religious ceremonies and festivals. The word is also used metaphorically to refer to the light of knowledge or wisdom.
